templates.name: Ledger
templates.best_for: Reports and deliverables meant to be printed and kept — analyses, reviews, annual write-ups. Warm paper, serif text, rules doing the organising.

templates.name: Signal
templates.best_for: Product and engineering briefs somebody scans on a laptop before a meeting. Tight sans, strong accent, structure visible from a scroll.

templates.name: Press
templates.best_for: Essays, arguments and long-form pieces read top to bottom. Narrow measure, magazine opener, large standfirst.

templates.name: Slate
templates.best_for: Technical notes carrying code, tables or measurements. Cool greys, monospace labels, hairline rules, small dense type.

templates.name: Atlas
templates.best_for: Briefings and strategy documents that need to feel authoritative without being stuffy. Large display sans over a serif text face, generous leading, numbered sections.
